marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to northwest 25 knots this afternoon then
diminishing to northwest 15 early Friday morning. Wind diminishing to light late
Friday morning. Scattered showers ending overnight. Fog patches dissipating
late this afternoon. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 2 to 3 early this evening then
subsiding to 2 Friday morning. Seas subsiding to 1 near noon
Friday.<br/>
